memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'Make Me a place, so I can live among you.'

sequence.prompt: How did God come to live with His people? Put it in order.

items.label: God asked for a place to live
The cloud came down and filled it

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Right in the middle of the camp
It showed them when to go and stay
He came and lived among us

application.question: God wanted to live right in the middle of His people. Where would you like God to be closest to you?
application.followUp: God walked with the very first family in the garden, He pitched His tent in the middle of the camp, and Jesus came and lived among us. Being with you was always the plan.
